name: Questioning Reethe
summary: Ogron has found Reethe at last and asks you to help question him. He says Reethe hid well for a human, though the days in the swamp may have driven him mad. Afterward, you return to Krog at Brackenwall Village.

sections.title: Ogron's Search
sections.body: Ogron has found Reethe after a long search. By Ogron's reckoning, Reethe hid well for a human. Yet Ogron fears the days in the swamp may have left Reethe mad, and wants you beside him for answers. Once you have spoken with Reethe, you return to Krog at Brackenwall Village.

sections.title: Back With Krog
sections.body: Krog is pleased that Reethe is gone from the swamp. He scorns humans as too frail to recover from even a small arrow wound. Krog decides this strand of the mystery led nowhere. The search must turn elsewhere.

faq.answer: Ogron found Reethe after a long search and wants you beside him to get answers.
Ogron fears Reethe may have gone mad after so long in the swamp.

faq.q: Who do you report to afterward?
aliases: where to turn in questioning reethe
who do i talk to after reethe
faq.answer: You report to Krog at Brackenwall Village.
